title: Randolph AFB 'accelerated learning' Skinner box program
place_text: Randolph Air Force Base, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: they said to the parents that it was an accelerated learning program with for children with very very high IQs

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author known for describing his own encounters with non-human beings, says that in 1952 children were taken into a program at Randolph Air Force Base in San Antonio, Texas, that involved Skinner boxes, closed chambers used in conditioning experiments. According to what he was told, parents were told it was an accelerated learning program for children with very high IQs. If true, the military was running experiments on gifted children under a false label.
